newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Fujimori leaves for Japan and SE Asia tour.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori leaves for Japan and SE Asia tour.

text.p: Peru's President Alberto Fujimori left Lima early on Tuesday for a two-day informal visit to Japan before starting a nine-day official tour of Southeast Asia that will include the Philippines, Thailand and Malaysia.

The tour is part of the government's drive to increase trade and joint investments with the Asian "tiger" nations and follows recent visits to Peru by Japan's Prime Minister Ryuatro Hashimoto and South Korea's President Kim Young-sam.

Fujimori, the son of Japanese immigrants, is a self-styled admirer of the Southeast Asian economies and has based his free-market reforms on a desire to transform the Peruvian economy along similar lines.

In the official part of his tour, he will meet with Philippines President Fidel Ramos, Thai King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa, and Malaysian King Yang di-Pertuan Agong and Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
